adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts), the decrypted `keys` payload is `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` and then written directly to `prisma.credential.update/create` as `key: keys` without any schema validation of the decrypted structure. Additionally, `JSON.parse(...)` (and potentially `symmetricDecrypt(...)`) can throw, and there is no try/catch around this trust-boundary operation, so a malformed payload would result in an unhandled 500. This matches the finding and is verifiable from the diff.
